source: Natural Earth 1:50m physical vectors (ne_50m_land, ne_50m_rivers_lake_centerlines), github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector master/geojson
source_licence: Natural Earth: all data are in the public domain (LICENSE.md, naturalearthdata.com terms of use). No permission needed; credit optional.
processing: land: shapely simplify 0.03 deg, polygons < 0.02 sq deg dropped, coordinates rounded to 0.01 deg; rivers: clipped to 55-92E 18-42N, simplify 0.005 deg, rounded to 0.001 deg, names kept. Physical layers only: no national borders are drawn from this source.
use: Orientation context for the globe and 3D views only. Never used in any count, harmonisation or statistic.
